files.description: Shop purchases (900 rows): purchase_id (whole number), subscriber_id (refers to subscribers.csv; most subscribers have several purchases), store_city (city name; the same city is written with different capitals and extra spaces, e.g. "lisbon" and "LISBON"; about 2% empty), quantity (whole number), spend (two decimals).

task_text: For every subscriber, add up all numeric columns of their purchases except the purchase id. `result` should be a table indexed by subscriber_id with the summed columns.
intended_computation: Group the 900 purchases by subscriber_id (302 subscribers) and sum quantity and spend; the subscriber_id is the index and is not itself summed.

acceptable_variants.notes: spend sums may be rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the applied function also receives the grouping column and sums the subscriber ids into a meaningless column

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
